import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f24 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0024.png').convert('RGB'))

# Find lamp base in F24
lamp_base = (f24[400:480, 320:430, 0] > 70) & (f24[400:480, 320:430, 0] < 120) & (f24[400:480, 320:430, 2] > 90)
y, x = np.where(lamp_base)
y_max = 400 + y.max()
x_mean = 320 + np.mean(x)
print('F24 Lamp base: y_max =', y_max, 'x_mean =', x_mean)

# Find cabinet in F24
# White face:
white = (f24[290:440, 110:190, 0] > 200) & (f24[290:440, 110:190, 1] > 200) & (f24[290:440, 110:190, 2] > 200)
yc, xc = np.where(white)
print('F24 Cabinet white face: y in', 290 + yc.min(), 290 + yc.max(), 'x in', 110 + xc.min(), 110 + xc.max())
"
